experiments.title: Acoustoelectric effect
experiments.summary: A surface acoustic wave drags carriers along and builds up a DC voltage (or current) in a conductor on its path. Its size follows the attenuation, so it tracks conductivity, quantum Hall states and magnetic order without contacts in the acoustic path.

gate.does: Tunes the carrier density of a 2D layer on the delay line.

cryostat.does: Sets temperature and a small field.

plans: V-I there and back
Fraunhofer pattern over ±1 mT

experiments.title: Tunneling spectroscopy (dI/dV)
experiments.summary: Add a small AC modulation to a DC bias and read the AC current with a lock-in: the differential conductance dI/dV of tunnel junctions, superconducting gaps, magnons and phonons in inelastic tunneling, and zero-bias anomalies.

bias.does: Sets the DC bias, through a divider.

lockin.does: Adds the AC modulation and reads the AC current.

iamp.does: Turns the junction current into a voltage at a virtual ground.

dmm.does: Reads the DC current from the preamplifier's output.

temperature.does: Holds the temperature; resolution is limited to about 3.5 kT.

plans: dI/dV over ±5 mV at the sample
dI/dV against temperature

experiments.title: Field-effect gate sweep
experiments.summary: Tune the carrier density with a gate and record the conductance: transfer curves, the charge-neutrality point or threshold, field-effect mobility and hysteresis from traps.

gate.does: Ramps the gate voltage and watches the leakage current.

lockin.does: Drives a small AC current and reads the four-probe voltage.

plans: Gate sweep from -10 V to 10 V and back

experiments.title: Hall effect and magnetoresistance
experiments.summary: Sweep the field and read the longitudinal and Hall voltages together: carrier type, density and mobility, multi-band transport, the anomalous Hall effect and magnetoresistance.

cryostat.does: Holds the temperature and sweeps the field.

lockin_xx.does: Drives the current and reads the longitudinal voltage.

lockin_xy.does: Reads the Hall voltage, locked to the first lock-in's reference.

plans: Field sweep at 2 K, -9 T to 9 T and back
Hall at six temperatures

experiments.title: Current-voltage characteristics
experiments.summary: Source a voltage and measure the current to see whether contacts are ohmic, find leakage and breakdown, and characterize diodes, junctions and other nonlinear devices. The first check on any new device.

smu.does: Sources the voltage and measures the current through the device.

voltmeter.does: Measures the voltage between inner contacts for a four-probe I-V.

plans: I-V there and back over ±100 mV

experiments.title: Landau fan and quantum oscillations
experiments.summary: Map the resistance against gate voltage and field: Landau levels, the quantum Hall effect, Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations, effective mass and quantum lifetime.

cryostat.does: Steps the field at a stable low temperature.

lockin_xx.does: Drives the current and reads Rxx.

plans: Gate sweeps at fields from 0 T to 9 T

experiments.title: Nonlinear Hall effect (second harmonic)
experiments.summary: Drive an AC current at ω and read the transverse voltage at 2ω: the second-order (nonlinear) Hall response from a Berry curvature dipole, skew scattering or magnetic order. The same lock-in method measures harmonic Hall signals of spin-orbit torque.

lockin_drive.does: Drives the current at ω and reads the first-harmonic voltages.

lockin_2w.does: Reads the transverse voltage at 2ω, locked to the drive.

plans: 2ω Hall voltage against the excitation amplitude
Temperature dependence at a fixed current
Field sweep at a fixed current, -9 T to 9 T and back

experiments.title: Resistance against temperature
experiments.summary: Four-probe resistance with a lock-in from room temperature to base: metal or insulator, phase transitions (charge density waves, magnetic order, superconductivity) and the residual resistance ratio.

lockin.does: Drives the current through a series resistor and reads the voltage between the inner contacts.

temperature.does: Steps or ramps the temperature and reads the thermometers.

preamp.does: Amplifies small voltages differentially before the lock-in.

plans: Log during a cooldown, every 10 s for 12 h
Stabilized steps from 300 K to 10 K

experiments.title: Pump-probe transient reflectivity
experiments.summary: A pump pulse excites the sample and a delayed probe pulse reads the change in reflectivity: carrier cooling and recombination, coherent phonons, and the recovery of ordered phases on femtosecond to nanosecond timescales.

laser.does: Femtosecond pulses, split into pump and probe (often with an OPA or harmonic for the pump).

delay.does: A linear stage that sets the pump-probe delay (6.67 fs per µm of travel in a double pass).

chopper.does: Chops the pump at a sub-harmonic of the repetition rate.

lockin.does: Reads the probe photodiode at the chopping frequency.

experiments.title: Rotational-anisotropy second-harmonic generation
experiments.summary: Focus femtosecond pulses on the sample and record the second harmonic while the light's polarization (or the scattering plane) rotates. The patterns fit the χ(2) tensor and reveal the point-group symmetry, and how it breaks at structural, electronic or magnetic transitions.

laser.does: Femtosecond pulses (Ti:sapphire near 800 nm, or a Yb laser near 1030 nm).

polarization.does: Rotates the incident polarization and the analyzer (half-wave plates or polarizers on rotation mounts).

detector.does: Counts the SHG photons through a short-pass and band-pass filter, or reads a PMT with a chopper and lock-in.

chopper.does: Chops the beam for lock-in detection.

cryostat.does: Holds the temperature across a transition.
